mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its historical average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (the 2019-08-15 level), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases the cost of capital and dampens corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals a monetary easing response to deteriorating labor market conditions, which is typically followed by negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS falls and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST above 1250 thousand units) indicate robust consumer demand and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1250 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (as defined by UNRATE < 4.0% and GDP growth > 2.0% annualized), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0% (the 2019-08-15 level), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust demand and supply chain strength, which is followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), a rising consumer price index signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and the economy is in a high-inflation regime (as defined by core inflation above 2.0% and wage growth above 3.0%), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
